latest_nl_proof: Assume m is an integer and m <= x < m + 1. By the defining property of the floor function, floor(x) is the unique integer r such that r <= x < r + 1. Since m itself is an integer satisfying m <= x < m + 1, it follows that m is exactly that unique integer. Therefore floor(x) = m.
